purpose: Authoritative scope reconciliation and evidence queue, NOT expert certification or approved learning bank.

checks.original_source_row_full_text_check: FNV32 of Unicode-NFKD whitespace-normalized stem+A+B+C from materialized SHA256-exact original XLSX compared to V141; 263/265 electrotechnics, 50/50 G1 legislation, 98/100 G1 norms matched; 4 expected mismatches; no other new differences discovered.

secondary_grade_II_sources_check.method: Normalized original G2 XLSX stem FNV32 per-row compared to all 568 V141 stems; this is exact normalized match only, not fuzzy/semantic deduplication. Unmatched rows are investigation candidates, NOT proof of 149 missing unique concepts.

current_external_2026_legal_source_evide.caveat: 2026 official scored examination answers are not inferred from fee table. The older 2024 legal source should not be cited as current 2026 authority; original answer values match order 82/2025.

risk_and_controls: BLOCK_RELEASE: 0/822 qualified independent signoffs, even where mathematical/source research aligns.
BLOCK_OFFICIAL_SOURCE_NATIVE_MAPPING: four QABC groups have material alterations from Excel (five G1/G2 grade routes), plus QABC-0145 only numeric formatting in two routes.

CHECK_G2_CONTENT_COVERAGE: compare 149 G2 original rows without exact stem-match against intended 153 teaching questions; user approval needed to change 822 bank's scope. This does NOT imply automatically adding 149 questions.
CHECK_ELEC_ORPHANS: eleven original E source rows (nine diagrams/figures, two text-only) are absent from V141 source-row mapping; do not add without image extraction and key evidence.

PREVENT_KEY_POSITION_LEAK: 153 synthetic didactic groups have all A correct in master. Test actual UI option shuffle, maintain text-to-key binding and A/B/C semantics on evaluation. Do not alter user-uploaded original choices.
KEEP_P0_P1_P2_QUEUES: 27 P0, 2 P1, 793 P2, and independent professional approval count remains 0.
NO_SOURCE_FILE_DISTRIBUTION: original workbook bytes remain in user's private Library and are not committed to GitHub.
